definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._extract_with_llamaindex

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._mineru_headers

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._extract_from_docx

definitions.declared_role: 从TXT/MD提取文本

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor.extract_with_metadata

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._fetch_mineru_metadata

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._get_extraction_method

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor.test_engines
definitions.declared_role: 测试各个引擎是否可用
notes: FUN-001: retain the explicit diagnostic dictionary; boolean availability is this health interface's result, not a fabricated extraction result.

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._test_mineru
definitions.declared_role: 测试MinerU连接
notes: ERR-002/RES-001: expected HTTP failures become False only in this named health check, with a bounded request and closed response.

definitions.name: DocumentLoader._infer_policy_type
